title: Elabora plan (plan.json)
description: The contract layer: the plan the client validates (objectives, ordered plan items, locked texts, assessment questions, sources). plan.json is always the working copy, written directly by the author and their agent at any time; its versions (V1, V2…: frozen copies made by hand, sent to the client, one of them validated) are in plan-versions/ (D52). Release builds need a validated version.

businessGoal.description: Business outcome the course serves (guardrail A4).

duration.description: The learner time the course is meant to take, in minutes, as the author or the client asked for it: a range (min and max, min not above max), one figure (min equal to max), a floor (min alone: longer than that, where an agent proposes several modules) or a ceiling (max alone). course.json durationMinutes is the time of the built course, written into the package.

decided.description: Before the plan is validated: what the agent decided by itself because the author left it open (a 3D scene, the tone, the format), which the author reads first in the app's Plan view and may change. Written in the course language, a few words each. Validating a version of the plan removes it, and it is outside the content hash: no version holds it, it is never part of the contract (D51).

topic.description: What was decided. The app names these topics as its « Nouveau module » page asks them: audience, duration, language, format, 3d, voices, business-goal, quizzes, case, tone, brand, accessibility, lms. Another topic needs a label.

label.description: The question as the author would ask it, for a topic the app does not name (« Un fil rouge ? »).

choice.description: What the agent chose (« Oui : le réseau du site, à explorer »).

why.description: Where it shows or why, in a few words (« partie 3, comme le demande le brief »).

items.description: The plan items the decision shapes.

question.description: Before the plan is validated: the one question the agent asks the author now, the one whose answer would change the plan most; the next comes once it is answered. The plan is written whole meanwhile. Validating a version of the plan removes it, and it is outside the content hash (D51).

text.description: The question, in the course language, that the author can answer in a sentence.

items.description: The plan items the answer would change.

sources.description: Sources of truth provided by the client or experts. Factual claims should cite them (guardrail G1).

type.description: For example internal procedure, regulation, expert interview.

statement.description: Observable behaviour: action verb, condition, criterion (guardrail A3). Avoid 'understand' or 'know' alone.

short.description: A short name of three to five words (« Les contrefaçons »), shown beside the objective's number wherever the plan refers to it. Optional: without it, the start of the statement.

criterion.description: Success criterion, for example 4 out of 5 scenarios solved.

items.description: Ordered storyboard items. Every item must be covered by at least one screen (guardrail A1), and every screen must cover at least one item.

spacing.description: Planned spaced retrieval after the module (guardrail B5), for example ["D+2", "D+7", "D+30"]. Delivered outside the package (LMS reminders, emails, micro-modules).

waivers.description: Approved exceptions to pedagogical warnings. They are listed in the proof report.

target.description: Optional id the waiver is limited to (screen, block, item).

translationOf.description: Set by elabora translate build: the source plan this one translates (its id, content hash and language). The translated plan needs its own approval (elabora translate approve), which the translated course holds as its validated version.

planTopic.description: A choice the author makes or leaves to the agent: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

kind.description: Pedagogical function. practice, scenario and assessment items need learner activity (retrieval, decision or production).

part.description: The part of the module the item belongs to, by its title (« Le texte du Gai Savoir »): consecutive items with the same part make one part, an item without one continues the part before it, and the course's sections follow them. Optional: a plan without parts takes those of course.json, the sections that hold its items' screens.

description.description: What the validated storyboard says this item contains.

voiceover.description: The voice-over the client validated for this item (a storyboard's voice-over column), line by line: a screen that covers the item takes it as its narration script (elabora narration from-plan, the app's « Reprendre la voix off du plan »).

speaker.description: A speaker of course.json speakers (default: the first).

text.description: Word for word what is said.

objectives.description: Objectives served. May be empty only for intro and summary items.

lockedTexts.description: Validated texts. Blocks reuse them with textRef, so the module always shows the plan's wording: rewording one on the canvas writes it here.

verbatim.description: The client wants this text as signed, « à l'identique » (a legal notice, a quote): only the author changes it, deliberately; agents' writes that change it are refused, and a change since the validated version is flagged (W_PLAN_VERBATIM_CHANGED).

questions.description: Validated questions. Quiz blocks reuse them with questionRef.

mode.description: single / multiple: choice question with options. numeric: the learner types a number (answer, tolerance, unit, feedback, misconceptions).

feedback.description: Elaborated feedback: why this option is right or wrong (guardrail D1).
